decision: Remove the unreleased joined_turns C entry and its public-wrapper dispatch; retain the exact original Python _joined body and the C build_pages dynamic call and dependency check.
basis: The complete existing cf1245 fixed-shape microdiagnostic shows the production wrapper slower in all three tested shapes. Direct-C improvement for only one shape does not offset the live guard and call boundary. No new timing was run for this decision.
scope: Retain the other native families, per-module immutable constants, Python fallback and all business behavior. Final candidate inventory becomes 22 (released seven plus fifteen new entries, including segmentation_ready and excluding joined_turns).
status: Implementation in progress; protocol 4 remains UNFROZEN. The old protocol 3 and all development evidence remain immutable.
final_acceptance: Use one complete isolated-hosted matrix after correctness/probe/source freeze. Local development timing is not release-performance evidence.
